balls.text: bangs it in short and he gets a thick top edge off the pull and the ball lands a few inches short of the fine leg rope!
slapped it back to the bowler and dropped! Rebounds to long-on and they scamper two
follows that up with a quicker one, the bouncer almost, fizzed past him
slower ball wide outside off and the batsman swings and misses
poor ball from Cooper! Slower ball and in the slot for Harbhajan to smack it over long-on, straighter this time
slams it down to long-on and it's only a single
even Harbhajan's tonking it! His first ball, seizes on a pitched up delivery and tees off several rows over long-on
makes room and slaps that wide of backward point and Cooper does a great job to slide and stop it
another slower ball and Franklin doesn't pick it, stays at the crease and tries to clear long-off, had quite a bit of power on the shot but not enough to beat Rahane
slower ball and he backed away and swished at it but the ball dropped short of deep extra cover
big swing and a miss, it was outside the off stumo
on the pads and worked with the angle down to long-on
dropped with soft hands down  to point for a quick single
makes room to a slower ball and swishes and misses, they sneak in a bye
soft dismissal! Karthik goes right across his stumps to paddle that over to fine leg but he scoops it tamely to Trivedi at short fine leg
so what if Pollard's out! Rayudu waits on a short delivery and deservedly flat-bats that several rows over long-on, picked the slower one
goes back and forehands that to Rahane at long-off
Relief for the Royals! Dropped a bit short and Pollard  goes back and slams that flat but down Rahane's throat at long-on
down the track and lofted but just short of long-on
slogged again and but this time straight to deep square leg
Royals' nightmare continues! Flatter delivery and Pollard slogs that and finds the gap at deep midwicket
over the wicket but it doesn't help! Few paces down and scooped easily over the sight-screen
the stumps get a hammering! At the other end that is, down the track and slams it just past the bowler's fingers, deflects off the stumps and nearly cleans up Aleem Dar! Scorches to long-off
good slower ball again, Pollard makes room but settles for a single to long-off
makes room and thumps it across the line to deep midwicket
fullish on the pads and clipped down to the on side
clears the front leg and whams it down the leg side and deep square leg cuts it off
the sixes continue! Pitched up and he clears the front leg and wallops it over wide long-on
down the track and he checks the shot and the ball dribbles off the pads
clips it just wide of short fine leg and keeps the strike
booming drive but Rayudu gets in the way! Owes him a couple of runs here
bowls it a touch short and he swivels and pulls hard down to deep midwicket, power!
gives the charge and slams it down to long-off
makes room and spoons the drive inside out just wide of point
fires in a full delivery and he jams it to the on side
down the leg side and tucked off the pads to short fine leg, 23 off the over
on the pads and whipped wide of square leg, some respite for Botha
leading edge! Tries to work that over the on side but there was so much power that the ball sailed over cover and even beat the sweeper
He comes round the wicket but it makes no difference! Fetches that from wide outside off and heaves it plenty of rows over deep midwicket
on to the second tier! Tossed up more, Pollard tees off and the ball goes several rows back and close to the camera equipment
not the best delivery, a bit short, Pollard waits for it to turn back in and clubs it just wide of Cooper at wide long-on
the leg cutter this time and Pollard moves across to work it to the leg side, clips his pad and rolls to the off side
comes down the track and slams it down to long-off, slight fumble by Botha but doesn't cost anything
another slower one and quietly tapped down to Rahane at point
slower ball and he chops it down to backward point
pitched up on middle and leg and Rayudu improvises and slogs that behind short fine leg, good use of the wrists there
whips it across the line down to deep square leg
drops it close to the pitch and calls early, Rayudu was too quick for Cooper who tried to boot it away to the stumps
fuller delivery and he plays it away down to long-on
this one skids through outside off and beats the edge as he tries to slash that
slams a full delivery straight to long-off
drops it shorter and it comes on to him quicker, quietly defends it
Pollard tees off! Length ball on middle and off and Pollard lofts him high over wide long-on
attempts another slog but the ball clips the top flap of the pad and lobs to the off side
makes room and the ball spins back in sharply, can only chop it to the off side
goes back and slaps it straight to midwicket
gets across and clips it to the on side
no it's not Pollard! Tossed up on middle and leg and Rayudu is on his knee and slogs that several rows over deep midwicket
goes for a slog and mistimes it to short fine leg
goes back and punches it against the turn to wide long-on tight over
makes room and punches it down to long-off
flatter delivery and Pollard is happy to defend, the lull before the storm?
down the track again and worked down to long-on
chips down the track and knocks it to the on side off his pads
keeps Pollrd quiet as he gets forward and defends
worked to the on side
didn't read the wrong un but he got away with it! Spins away and the ball beats the edge and the keeper's gloves and first slip, the umpire thought he edged it though, should have been given byes
on the pads and clipped to the on side
leading edge and the ball drops safe towards mid-off

the 41-year-old is having a party! Tossed up and full, the ball spins back in and Levi tries to work it with the spin but he left a big gap between pad and bat and was bowled through the gate, Hogg takes off in celebration
made room but the ball spun back in and tucked him up, managed to punch it to long-off
shuffled at the crease before delivery, another slower delivery which he clips it to square leg
on middle and leg and he clips it down to midwicket
drifts on the leg stump and he stabs it down to long-on
fuller delivery and a bit slower, he flicks it late to deep square leg
Rayudu also waits on it and angles it down to third man
waits for it and clips it down to wide long-on
spins away and he steers that wide of backward point
Hogg takes off! Rohit made himself room to dab that to the off side but the ball spun back in from outside off and flattened his off stump, he was expecting that to turn away from him
comes forward and drives to cover
beaten by he turn! Spun quite sharply and beat him as he made room to heave it
sweeps conventionally to short fine leg
Levi greets him with a reverse sweep! Low full toss from over the wicket, picked that early and sent it scorching to third man
on the pads and worked to the leg side
makes room and slices it down to backward point, tried to pierce the gap between him and short third man
gave that a heave! Fetches that from the off stump, a bit too short and he heaved that high and over deep midwicket
punches it towards mid-on and thinks of a single but sends his partner back
sprays it on the pads and he works it down to deep midwicket
tucks him up for room and he knocks it back to the bowler
deliberately done! There was no slip and Levi waited for it, dabbed it late comfortably past the keeper and down to third man
tries to squeeze out a yorker wide outside the off stump
slower ball but he directs it down the leg side, clipped the pad slightly
on the hips and he turns it to the leg side
another Rohit special, half volley outside off and he plays an effortless extra cover drive, nobody bothered chasing it
full delivery on middle and leg and he pushes it to mid-on, sliding stop but the ball deflects off the fielder
punched back to the bowler and Amit tries to fling it back to the stumps
gets forward and he clips it down to mid-on
eases off the mark in most elegant manner! Short and wide and he timed that slice really well past backward point
Terrific catch by Trivedi! Amit Singh bowls it full, Suman gathers to slam that over the off side, Trivedi times his dive to his left at mid-on and just about plucks it and hangs on
run-out chance! Pushed towards wide mid-on and the fielder has a shy, a direct hit by Cooper would have sent Levi back
nicely done, dropped to the off side for a quick single to get the big-hitting Levi on strike
he wrecks Chavan's figures! Tossed up a bit more, on his knee early and it's a clean slog that sails flat over deep midwicket, 21 off the over
slower through the air and defended back to the bowler
Chavan floats it towards the leg side and Levi is on his knees and sweeps hard to fine leg
gave that a thump! Makes room and bashes it off the front foot wide of mid-on
down the leg side and the ball clips the pads and rolls away
straight over the sightscreen! Suman gives the charge and lofts cleanly over the bowler's head, neat follow through
opens the face of the bat and steers him to third man
clipped wide of mid-of for a single
comes forward and he's beaten for pace and movement
collision and a tumble! He drops the ball on the pitch and risks the single, Amit and Levi sprint to the other and they collide as the bowler picks up the ball, he has a shy at the stumps but misses
fuller delivery and punched off the front foot to Rahane at point
outside edge and dropped short of first slip! The fielder was too far back
swept firmly but straight to short fine leg, nice tight opening over
chipped in the air down to the vacant midwicket region
more air this time and it slides to the pads again
Chavan skids this through and it hits the pads and rolls to the off side
gets forward and defends back to the bowler
spin to begin with, comes forward and blocks it down the track
Munaf will now take the Purple Cap! He has ten wickets overall and finishes off the game, Hogg swings across the line and hits it flat to Franklin at deep midwicket
backs away and places a low full toss to long-on
bowls it shorter and he makes room and clears extra cover
full outside off and drilled down to long-off
the stumps elude Malinga again, moves away to smash that but was nowhere near it
how did that miss the leg stump? Backed away, swing and a miss
Trivedi backs away a long way and has a desperate swing at it, slower ball which just misses the off stump
fast yorker on the middle stump and he steers it down to deep point
too quick for Hogg, the yorker beats him outside off
makes room and the yorker swings away from the off stump and beats him
slower ball and he pushes it down to long-on
Pollard's made the night his own! Slower ball and the batsman makes a lot of room, exposes his stumps and fails to pick it, clips the leg stump
bounces him and it's a no-ball for height
bowls the hat-trick ball outside off, slower one, he misses
that's two out of two for Pollard! Bowls it short to Chavan, he tries to pull but the bounce was too steep for comfort, he bent his knee while swinging at it and managed a thick edge to Karthik
Pollard hits back! Bowls it fuller and angles it across him, Menaria stays back at the crease and tries to loft him over the off side, skied to Rohit at the covers
terrible ball considering fine leg is up in the circle, friendly short delivery down the leg side, swivels and pulls to fine leg
starts off with a short one wide down the leg side, tries to pull but  misses
still some drama left, Chavan made room and carved a short delivery wide of third man, good placement
timber! Despite being tonked for six Munaf isn't afraid to bowl it full on the stumps again, this time he bowls the slower one, Cooper makes room and swings and the off stump goes two yards back
Improvisation! Cooper sensed that Munaf would target his stumps, backed and launched that to the sight screen, swift follow through
full delivery this time and he slams it down to long-off
keeps it short to Menaria and he backs away and tries to launch that to third man but misses
short, steep delivery fizzing past the left-hander! Too good for Menaria
full toss! This gets more interesting, on the body and whammed over deep midwicket, went miles up in the air
low full toss fired on the pads and it deflects to short third man, Cooper scampers back and the throw is wide
makes room and jams it down to long-off, only a single
full on the pads and thudded down to long-on
Maneris makes room and slaps it to cover, rushes the single and beats the throw
fires that full and he jams it down to long-off
fires that towards the stumps and he can only push it softly to cover
Menaria was foxed by that one which was full and he wasn't sure what to do, nearly scooped it towards the keeper

that's a double-strike for Malinga! The off cutter and Botha fetches that from outside off and tries to clear the on side, it was high but not far enough to beat Pollard who takes it and pumps his fist
bangs it in short and stays back and pulls that over midwicket, miscued but safe
bangs it in short and he ducks under that bouncer

when in doubt turn to Malinga! Shah was already standing wide of the leg stump to give himself room, too much in fact because he failed to dig out the yorker shaping on off and middle stumps, misses it and the off stump lies splattered
watch out  for Menaria! Pollard bowls a slower one and Menaria gets his high backlift down and deposits that several rows over wide long-on
slower ball on the pads and he works it to square leg
a touch wide outside off and he pulls it down to long-on
comes round the wicket and he pushes it down to long-on
whack! Slower ball fetched from the off stump and clubbed across the line, flat six over deep midwicket
Game on! Pollard drops it a fraction short, Shah makes room and pulls in front of square, just beats deep midwicket's dive in vain
16 off the over! Menaria slams that down the ground to long-off and Pollard slides, cuts it off and the ball deflects to the rope, he punches the rope in frustration
makes room and carves that flat and quick down to sweeper cover
now Shah makes room and another flatter delivery is smacked, this time over long-on, top shot
makes room and Harbhajan fires it flat, it's a low full which Shah bludgeons cleanly to long-off, Malinga couldn't cut that off
Menaria makes room and cuts hard straight to point
fires it flat and he gets an inside edge to the pads
gives him width and he steers it to Munaf at third man
bowls wide of the crease and fires it full there's a misfield at cover
another crisp hit and it's 50 for Shah! Length ball on the pads and he gets on his knee and cleanly slogs him over deep square leg
punches it down to Harbhajan at point for a quick single
looks to swing him square on the leg side from outside off, is hit on the pads, Pollard thinks it is worth an appeal

eep, Rahane has holed out to long on, and his home crowd is delighted, it is Pollard who gets the breakthrough, Rahane looked to punch a length ball from the crease, seemed to stop on him, and he ended up spooning it straight to long on
gives him a wide full toss, Owais throws his bat at it, and the thick edge flies past short third man
fires it in very full, and Owais can only hit it back to the bowler
turning down the pads, tucked square for one
excellent placement from Ajinkya, he skips down the track, and opens the face to loft the tossed up ball past extra cover
swings a near-yorker along the ground to long on
charges out, gets too close to the pitch, and finds extra cover
slower ball and clipped to the deep on the on side
great placement! Drops it short and Shah clubs it flat and past square leg, bisects the gap between two fielders
on the pads and clipped down to deep square leg
slower ball and cramps him for room, he can only push it back to the bowler
angles it inwards and he clips it towards midwicket
gets across and taps it down the track
down the track and jams out a full delivery to the off side
goes back and slaps it hard down to sweeper cover where Ojha slides and gets a hand to it, lucky it didn't roll back to the rope
flatter delivery again and flicked firmly to the deep on the on side
comes forward and jams it back to the bowler
fires it flat and full on seeing him down the track, jammed out to long-off
makes room and slaps it to deep backward point
one of the more effortless sixes seen today! Rahane was down the track, merely scooped a length ball with little effort and it hit the sight-screen, sound follow through
gently clipped to the leg side for an easy single
clipped down to wide long-on for a single
down the track and nearly yorks himself, brings up the 50 stand with a single to long-off
tossed up and he comes forward and drives to long-off
makes a lot of room and he works it with the angle to wide long-on
keeper up to the stumps, nice and tight, he pushes it back to the bowler
poor delivery, low full toss outside the off stump and he follows that and gently dabs it between the gap at point and short third man
tucks it down to deep square leg
run-out chance! Pushed to cover, the throw was too wide for Karthik to collect and whip off the bails, Shah was sent back and Karthik couldn't throw it back to the stumps
drifts down the leg side and it's way too wide, couldn't control the slower ball
stays back and knocks it to the off side
you should have seen that travel! Fractionally short and he read the length early and smacked it down to deep midwicket, rocketed off the bat
makes a lot of room again and he slams it to the covers
backs away a long way and drives inside out straight to point
clean hit! Tossed up down the leg side and he gets on his knee and sweeps him a few rows over deep square leg
goes back and thumps it down to deep square leg
bounces a bit more, Rahane makes room to cut but he's beaten completely
down the track and he fires it flat, worked down to short fine
on the pads and clipped down to midwicket
flat! Overpitched and Shah went forward slightly and scooped it flat and quick over long-off
moves across and flicks uppishly towards Pollard in the deep
Frankin strays on the pads, shuffles across and whips it wide of short fine leg and Pollard, yes 'that' man in action again, slides and cuts off a sure boundary
good length outside off and punched down to mid-off
on the pads and softly turned away wide of short fine leg for a single
turned to the on side for a quick single
gets forward and pushes it towards cover
heads up! Rahane comes down the pitch, fetches a short delivery and clubs it high and a few rows back over deep midwicket
back of a length and Rahane gets across and taps it down the track
Rahane decides enough is enough and he chips down the track and slams a length delivery over mid-off
Munaf beats him! Tucks him up and the ball holds its line and beats the edge
sharp bouncer and it just fizzes over his helmet! Malinga's giving little away
nips it back in and softly clipped to the on side for a quick single
a little too straight and he works it behind square on the on side for a couple
Malinga's really tucking him up, no width and Rahane can only quietly knock it back to the bowler
a bit slower in pace and still straight, checks his shot to the on side
on the angle just outside off and gently steered to the off side
back of a length and he shuffles and clips it down to fine leg
too full and straight, he whips it in front of his pads wide of midwicket
Munaf's on a hat-trick! He lands it outside off and Goswami shapes to drive through the off side, didn't bounce as much and it took the inside edge to the keeper, Karthik knew it instantly
soft dismissal! Dravid tries to swing that anywhere over the on side, back of a length outside off, top edge swirls to Suman at mid-off
tucks him up for room back of a length and Dravid can't beat the gap at cover
good use of the wrists and well timed but he can't get it past midwicket
tucks him up for room with a pacy delivery and he can only push it to the off side
gets across and taps it towards mid-off
just shorter in length and they safely leave it alone to the keeper
on the pads and whipped away wide of fine leg, uses his wrists well, top shot, no risk at all
just opens the face of the bat and steers it down to third man, travelled quickly and well stopped
leading edge! Tries to work it to the on side but it's safe of cover
